values.en: The **affine embedding** is the map $\iota\colon\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{R}}$, $\iota(x,y)=[x:y:1]$. Its image is the set of projective points admitting a representative with third coordinate $1$, that is the piece $Z\neq 0$; for $Z\neq 0$ the inverse coordinates are $x=X/Z$, $y=Y/Z$. The map $\iota$ is injective.
values.zh-CN: **仿射嵌入**是映射 $\iota\colon\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{R}}$，$\iota(x,y)=[x:y:1]$。其像由那些具有第三坐标为 $1$ 的代表三元组的射影点组成，即 $Z\neq 0$ 的那一片；当 $Z\neq 0$ 时逆坐标为 $x=X/Z$，$y=Y/Z$。映射 $\iota$ 是单射。
